name: com.amplerun/gpu-rentals
title: AmpleRun GPU rentals
description: Find, price, rent and stop GPUs on AmpleRun. Paid in USDC or USDT on Base. Flat 5% fee.

environmentVariables.name: AMPLERUN_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: AmpleRun API key (ark_...) from Account → Security. list_templates and search_offers work without it.

environmentVariables.name: AMPLERUN_MCP_ALLOW_SPEND
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to allow create_rental and stop_rental. Unset keeps the server read-only.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: AmpleRun API key from Account → Security. The renter scope allows renting and stopping.
